verdict.rationale: Mintlify documents an analytics dashboard covering documentation traffic, assistant conversations, search queries, engagement, and reader feedback. Nothing in the evidence says traffic is segmented into AI-agent visitors versus human readers. Assistant-conversation metrics and the vague 'Advanced insights' tier are adjacent features, not agent-versus-human traffic attribution.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, my docs analytics distinguish AI-agent traffic from human traffic so I can see who — or what — is actually reading
